profiles.Summary: OMORI is an extremely lightweight 2D RPG Maker MV title that the Steam Deck handles with ease, running at a locked 60 fps with minimal power draw. It is rated Playable on Steam Deck with a strong gold/trending-platinum ProtonDB record, meaning it works well under default Proton with little to no configuration needed.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were found; profiles are estimated from the game's very modest PC minimum requirements (Intel N4100, DirectX 9 GPU) and its 2D RPG Maker MV engine.
